title: ZoneErrorCodes
description: Fixed known codes of the auth/v1 error registry. The registry is open: unknown codes are legal on the wire and must hit an unknown-fallback, but these constants are stable and machine-matchable. Clients judge by code/retryable, never by message.

codes.description: zone_id fails the admission format/reserved rules.
zone_id is kernel-owned (root/__control__) and not creatable by tenants.
A zone with the requested identity already exists.
No zone with the given identity is visible to the caller.
Patch attempted to change an immutable field (zone_id, origin trust domain, created_by, history).
If-Match/revision is stale; the resource changed concurrently.
The operation requires an active zone (suspended blocks new runtimes and writes; deleting blocks new grants/runtimes/mounts).
The zone still hosts runtimes/sessions/mounts that block the requested transition.
Deprovision blocked by retention, active grants, mounts, sessions or exports.
The physical zone runtime could not be reached or provisioned.
Raft quorum for the zone is unavailable.
No such grant.
Grant exists but is not active (pending/revoked/expired grants carry no access).
The grant has been revoked.
The grant's expires_at has passed (judged at access time).
The authoritative Moss membership service is temporarily unavailable; access remains denied and may be retried.
Active ZoneGrant holds but the resource-level ReBAC relation does not; both layers must hold to allow.
Same Idempotency-Key with a different canonical request hash.
api_version carries a major this endpoint does not support; unknown majors are rejected by default.
The capability code is known but not enabled for this zone/principal.
Mandatory projections (ReBAC edges, API-key/delegation, caches) are not yet materialized; grant stays pending and access is denied.
Mandatory projection materialization failed; worker may retry.
